page.title: Everything in Yakın Çevrem
page.text: Schedule, plans, Agenda, projects, chat and the couple space; it's all below.
page.legendSoon: Coming soon: planned, subject to change.
page.legendPro: Pro: voice and video calls; everything free stays free.

items.weekly: Weekly schedule: classes, work, gym, whatever you've got
items.dayByDay: Swipe through your schedule day by day
items.freeTime: Find free time together and turn it into a meetup in one tap
items.compare: Compare schedules: Me · Partner · Together, and with anyone from their profile
items.scheduleVisibility: Choose, person by person, who sees your schedule
items.status: A status that stays (like WhatsApp's "About"; or just until tomorrow or for a week) and personal status shortcuts
items.meetups: Meetups day by day ("Today, Tomorrow, Next Saturday"): invites with a personal note; Going · Maybe · Can't go, with a note
items.meetupChanges: Suggest another time; everyone is asked again when the time or place changes; participant notes
items.liveMeetup: Live meetup: "Start the meetup", time elapsed and left, "I'm here", who came and who didn't, +30 min / +1 h, "End" (undo within 10 minutes)
items.homeLive: A banner at the top of the home screen for a meetup that is on or about to start
items.meetupStarters: Quick starts (movie, series, game, going out) and your recent places
items.remote: Remote join link, add to calendar, reminders
items.sameCityFirst: People in the same city shown first when you invite
items.agendaOnce: Agenda: one-off tasks and lists (quantity, date, priority); just for you or shared
items.agendaRoutine: Routines: pick days and times (medicine, vitamins, workout); reminded on time, ticked off hour by hour
items.agendaToday: "Today" view and ready-made lists: groceries, cleaning, travel bag
items.water: A water reminder that splits your daily need, based on your weight, across your waking hours (only you see your weight and height)
items.partnerView: Me · Partner · Together: the meetups, projects and Agenda your partner shares, and how you're both doing
items.offline: Every screen is kept on your phone: offline you still see the latest state; messages, statuses, Agenda items and schedule entries go out when you're back online
items.agendaUpcoming: "Upcoming" view in the Agenda and streaks for routines ("5 days in a row")
items.recurringMeetups: Recurring meetups; turn a finished meetup into a memory in one tap
items.projectTypes: Project types: software, web, mobile, business, event, research, general
items.startGuide: Guided start: "What is this project?", "How clear is it?"; compare Planned, Kanban, Scrum, Hybrid and Discovery and choose yourself; your reason is kept under "Method and decisions"
items.standards: Personal work standards: "Apply my standards"; pick a template's weeks and tasks one by one and read why each is there
items.strategy: Strategy: project brief and "Tools": the 12 stages of a business plan and a readiness score from the tools you chose
items.guidedTools: Nine guided tools: Persona, competitor matrix, SWOT → TOWS, risk matrix, Lean Canvas, goals (OKR), user stories, MVP scope, technology questions
items.toolGuides: Every tool goes question by question with examples; "I don't know" is fine and is saved as an assumption to check. "How to prepare" guides, saved versions; "Still useful?" for a tool untouched for 30 days; stories become tasks, the MVP goes onto the roadmap
items.aiExport: Markdown export for AI: type, audience (team / client), names replaced by roles, open questions; copy to clipboard or download a .md file
items.roles: Roles: Project lead, Manager, Member, Viewer
items.review: Assign work, "Send for review", approve or send back with a note, item history
items.assigned: "Assigned to me": one list across all projects
items.teamTab: Team tab: workload per person, items waiting for review, handing over the lead
items.views: List, Kanban board (drag and drop, WIP limits) and Gantt timeline
items.dependencies: Dependencies, critical path, delay warnings; weekend and working-hours settings
items.roadmap: Roadmap: phase → epic → feature → task; MoSCoW priority, acceptance criteria, estimates
items.issueKeys: Task numbers (CAFE-12) and task history: who changed what, and when
items.trash: 30-day trash for tasks: a deleted task comes back with its subtasks
items.pagePlans: Page-by-page plans for web and mobile, designs, version history, notes pinned on images
items.changeRequests: Change suggestions (word-by-word diff) and approval flow
items.templates: Template library: 8 ready-made templates plus ones shared by your people
items.partnerProjects: Start a project for your partner, follow your partner's projects
items.revenuePlan: Revenue, cost and cash plan, rate calculator, "How do I get my app built?" guide
items.projectInvites: Email invites and workspaces for freelancers, small teams, companies and communities
items.clientSpace: Client space: sharing, requests, approvals and delivery sign-off
items.timeTracking: Time tracking, client-approved time summaries, payment milestones
items.narratives: Separate write-ups for client, business and engineering; "Is this still right?" checks
items.sprints: Your own workflow, sprints, backlog, retrospectives; multiple assignees and attachments
items.talkAbout: "Talk about it": tag a meetup, shared plan, project, page, task or schedule; "Start a group with everyone"
items.tagTodos: Tag Agenda items, project weeks and tasks (by number), schedule entries, memories, shared lists and comments in chat; the card shows status and progress
items.reactions: Reactions, replies, edit history, delete for me or for everyone
items.chatTheme: Shared chat theme: colour, pattern, font
items.photos: Send photos, search in chat, pinned messages
items.linkPreview: Link previews; watch YouTube, Vimeo and video files inside the app
items.mediaLinks: "Media and links": a chat's photos and links in one place
items.ticks: Sent, delivered and read ticks; typing and online indicators
items.lastSeen: Last seen in one-to-one chats; hide it if you like
items.notifReply: Reply or mark as read from the notification, mute chats
items.notifRich: Message notifications with the sender's photo, stacked messages and a summary; notifications in the reader's language
items.encrypted: Messages stored encrypted on the server (not end-to-end)
items.notifPreview: Notification previews encrypted with your device's key, and you can turn them off
items.multiPhoto: Multiple photos and a chat gallery
items.couplePlans: Shared plans: "this or that?", "you decide", approve with a new time
items.coupleCard: Couple card, "days together", a soft pink theme
items.memories: Memories: many photos, a month-by-month timeline, albums, comments, "a year ago today"
items.photoDays: Photo days: a daily theme, photos revealed together, streaks, a month calendar, collages
items.games: Games together: This or that, How well do you know me?, Tic-tac-toe, Connect four, Draw and guess, Finish the story
items.newGames: New games: Say it together, Two truths and a lie, 60-second list
items.us: "Us": dates like when you met and your first date, countdowns
items.loveLanguage: Love-language quiz (20 questions) and plan ideas to match
items.archive: If you break up, the shared space stays in a read-only archive for 30 days
items.memoryExtras: Editing memories, turning a meetup into a memory, an "Our week" summary
items.addByUsername: Add friends and your partner by username, requests
items.profile: Profile: city, school or work, interests (optional); "same city", "shared interests"
items.timeZone: Local time for people in other time zones
items.languages: Turkish and English; follows your phone, changeable in Settings
items.theme: Light and dark theme, accent colour, text size
items.homeCards: Grouped home screen (Now · Soon · My people · My projects); reorder or hide cards
items.globalSearch: Search everything: people, meetups, projects, tasks (by number), pages and the Agenda; accents and capitals don't matter
items.accessibility: Large text and screen reader support; "Move" on the board without dragging
items.notifications: Notifications by category, quiet hours, per-channel settings
items.closedNotifs: Notifications while the app is closed (Android)
items.permissions: Notifications and permissions screen, test notification
items.onboarding: First-run intro, profile guide, help page
items.releaseNotes: Release notes and "What's next?" inside the app
items.webApp: Web version: the same account in your browser
items.perPerson: Per-person sharing: schedule, status, projects, Agenda, meetups
items.optionalInfo: Personal details are optional, each with its own visibility
items.blockReport: Block and report: people, messages, comments, meetups, memories, templates
items.moderation: A moderation team reviews reports, accounts are restricted for violations, reporters stay anonymous
items.deleteAccount: Permanent account deletion, password change, forgot password
items.legalInApp: Privacy policy and terms of use in the app and on this site
items.appLock: App lock, sign out of all devices
items.twoFactor: Two-step verification, list of signed-in sessions
